authority: Non-authoritative P2 display vocabulary; descriptive only

rules.implementation: declared source only; hard limits; canonical anchors and recommended forms; nothing derived from cube.flow, code or logs
closed kind set with distinct line/head styles; depth-first numbering; labels wrapped to two lines, never truncated; fixed pitch; returns only when declared; no time axis
alt/opt/loop, depth <= 2; guards and bounds are declared text, never evaluated; frames span the touched participants
participants/messages/depth per window; summarize windows between top-level items; detail never continues; depth never summarized
one panel per trigger window; (trigger, message) coverage; check-panels re-renders every input; text-only trigger index
RETURN_UNMATCHED / RETURN_UNDECLARED warnings from declared messages only
neutral lens only; declared_unverified; no causation, success, authority or time is drawn or reported
own package vpsequence; local CLI only; no G4/G5/MCP change
